# SCOOP

> SCOOP is a web app that turns school emails, WhatsApp messages, newsletters and flyer text into one calm family plan. You paste the message; it pulls out the events, deadlines, tasks and RSVPs; you review and edit them; they go into a plan you can tick off.

SCOOP is built for parents and carers who are the default keeper of the family calendar. It is phone-first and runs in any modern browser.

## What it does
- Paste any school message: an email, a WhatsApp thread, a newsletter or flyer text.
- Extract items using AI (Groq tool calling). A built-in on-device parser is the fallback when no AI key is configured or the AI call fails, and it does not send your text anywhere.
- Show every extracted item for review: edit the title, date, time, location and notes, or remove it, before anything is saved.
- Sort items into four types: events, deadlines, tasks and RSVPs.
- Filter a plan to Today, This Week or All, and mark items done or delete them.
- Push a dated item to Google Calendar, or download it as an .ics file.

## What it does not do yet
- Forwarding emails straight into SCOOP
- Scanning paper flyers from a photo
- A WhatsApp integration
- Reminders or notifications
